name: io.github.illescasDaniel/codenav-mcp
title: CodeNav
description: Python code navigation and type-checked refactoring through MCP, powered by ty.

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Project root the server serves (never overridden); default follows the client's MCP roots, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or the working directory

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_SOURCE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory scanned for implementations candidates and used to derive dotted import paths (e.g. src); default is the whole workspace

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true/yes/on to make write tools refuse to write (previews and checks still work)

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_EXTRA_SOURCE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directories (e.g. tests) that implementations also scans; matches are listed under a separate heading

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum characters of one tool result (default 30000); longer results end with an omission note

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_ALLOW_READONLY_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true/yes/on to let write tools overwrite read-only (0444) Python files and keep their mode

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_EXCLUDE_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory names added to the built-in list of directories that are never scanned or written

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_INCLUDE_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory names removed from that list, for example build to treat a first-party build/ package as source

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_MAX_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of Python files (.py/.pyi) a workspace may hold (default 250000); a larger tree is refused before the language server starts

environmentVariables.name: CODENAV_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where previews and the applied-edit history are kept across restarts, one subdirectory per workspace (default $XDG_STATE_HOME/codenav-mcp or ~/.local/state/codenav-mcp)
